name: Bloodmaster's Ring
summary: A fight with Bonegnaw is the next bout toward becoming champion in the Bloodmaster's Ring. The ogres are waiting to see whether you can give them a battle worth watching.

sections.title: The Next Bout
sections.body: Your wins have not made you a champion yet, and the ring's goblin has another battle in mind. Bonegnaw is your opponent, and the goblin promises a surprise. The ogres are watching, and the next bout is meant to entertain them.

sections.title: After the Fight
sections.body: The goblin is displeased with how the bout reflects on him. The ogres, however, seem entertained, and he warns you against taking pride in the outcome.

faq.answer: Bonegnaw is your opponent in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
The ring's goblin says your wins have not made you a champion yet.
Ogres are watching the bout in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
